snippet.title: Tsugunohi -The Thread That Beckons to Heaven- // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4830660/Tsugunohi_The_Thread_That_Beckons_to_Heaven

Just keep walking left. The latest Tsugunohi returns to the series’ roots with its early visual style and atmosphere. On a sweltering summer day, a girl walks home past “righteous” people, a thread of salvation, and her mother beneath a white umbrella. Is that hand salvation—or a curse?

Developed by
Vaka Game Magazine and ImCyan
